text:
The judge session did the work the brief asked for, with one small inefficiency.

- **Files opened:** The judge read the triage note (turn 2) and then opened the code and spec files the findings name (turns 4-6, 8, 12, 15).
- **Verdict:** The turn 17 text is cut off in the view. It concludes criterion 1 is PARTIAL because one claim is wrong, and it quotes lines from the files it read. I can't see its verdict on criterion 2, so I make no claim about it.
- **Search that returned almost nothing:** The `workflows register` search was run twice (turns 11 and 13). Both returned only 22 and 32 characters, so they probably found nothing. The second search may have had a different scope, so I rate this low confidence.
- **Re-read file:** The spec was read twice (turns 8 and 12), but the output sizes differ (1705 vs 3538 chars), so these were probably different ranges and not wasted.
- **Conformance:** The header lists no prompt sections, lessons, skills or subagent types, so there is nothing to grade for conformance.
